about_the_game:
The game is about poor human workers who put all their money together and bought an old, rusty, but still flying space cargo freighter. You will have to fulfill orders for cargo transportation from different factions. Do you want to serve the galactic authoritarian mega-corporation - E.Corp., work for the newly formed "Trade Federation" to counter E.Corp or will you side with the Cosmic Pirates and do not very legal things?

There are three space freighters in the game, and you can upgrade it as you like. The more improvements and completed orders you have, the further you delve into the story of ordinary hard workers who just wanted to make some money. You can purchase modules for the ship at specialized trading stations. Along the way, you will refuel at gas stations, disinfect at special sanitary stations, and simply find ruins and abandoned stations for your exploration.

If you think that everything is very simple, then you are deeply mistaken. The game features a variety of events that will be both positive and negative. You can get into a zone of cosmic turbulence, in which your rusty cargo carrier can start sorting out for spare parts; fly through a beautiful nebula; meet aliens behind the portholes of your ship; risk flying through a black hole and find out what happens (This is a brilliant idea, right?); meet small 15 cm dwarfs who drilled out of Your ship's bathroom and who really want to take over your ship (Umm, we ourselves are not sure what we used when we came up with this).

The game will also feature skins for astronauts (Absolutely FREE), lots of Easter eggs, and exciting and varied missions, the duration of which varies from 10 to 45 minutes. Unusual mechanics that are not found in inspired projects: a clone rebirth system, the mechanics of taking loans (We advise you to pay it on time!), it will be possible to transport plants, animals, people and even microbiological creatures! For each type of cargo, you will have to take care of it in certain ways, adjust the conditions so that the cargo reaches the point of arrival in integrity and safety.

We remind you that this project was done by several young students, so in our game you can find AI-generated content and free assets/sounds/music/etc. We ask you to understand, enjoy Our project and taste the hard life of poor hard workers!

Inspired by projects such as: Lethal Company, R.E.P.O., Void Crew.
